```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

```{r}
# penguins <- penguins %>% rename(body_mass_g = body_mass, flipper_length_mm = flipper_len, bill_length_mm = bill_len, bill_depth_mm = bill_dep)
```

# Plots

## Row 1

```{r}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and comes from the `palmerpenguins`
package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands in the 
Palmer Archipelago

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |> 
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
